about:
MedQuest Home Medical Equipment is a durable medical equipment supplier headquartered in Williston, North Dakota. The company operates from a storefront at 1602 11th Street West, where it is open Monday through Friday from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed in public listings.

The firm supplies home medical equipment, mobility aids, and related consumables to patients and caregivers throughout the Williston area. Its offerings include wheelchairs, walkers, hospital beds, respiratory devices, and other assistive products prescribed for at-home use. MedQuest coordinates with local healthcare providers to verify prescriptions, handle insurance billing, and arrange delivery and setup.

Customers range from individuals recovering from surgery or managing chronic conditions to clinics and hospitals that refer patients for equipment needs. The supplier serves the durable medical equipment and home healthcare industries, focusing on timely fulfillment within the local market.
